name: AGC 198507 (Hubble)
blurb: AGC 198507, a gas-rich dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: agc198507-hubble
story: A small, gas-rich dwarf galaxy picked out of a radio survey by the hydrogen it carries, living alone: no other galaxies were found within 1 Mpc of it. Hubble resolved its red giant stars to measure how far away it is.

claims.text: AGC 198507 is a SHIELD II target of Hubble program 13750, 'Fundamental Parameters of the SHIELD II Galaxies'
SHIELD galaxies are gas-rich dwarf galaxies
SHIELD galaxies were selected from the ALFALFA radio (HI) survey catalog
The Hubble imaging was used to measure distances from the tip of the red giant branch
A TRGB distance was measured for AGC 198507
No galaxies were identified within 1 Mpc of AGC 198507
